facilities_note: Mapped facilities only; operation, staffing, fleet, capacity and flood-time availability are unknown. Schools are potential relief sites, not designated camps.

road_graph.topology: Shared OSM node IDs only. No planar intersections or snapped bridge crossings. AOI boundary clips are unique per road segment.
road_graph.limitations: OSM completeness and current access unknown. Turn restrictions and conditional restrictions are not implemented. AOI-truncated routes cannot detour outside the grid. No inferred bridge deck elevations.
road_graph.speed_assumptions: Fallback speeds are modelling assumptions, not observed travel speeds. No live traffic; no emergency one-way override.

population.limitations: Modelled 2020 residential population, not current occupancy or observed evacuations. 10m allocation adds no demographic detail.
population.method: Source pixel count multiplied by UTM polygon intersection area/source pixel area; contributions summed into exact 10m cells. Incomplete source coverage stays NoData. Uniform density inside each native pixel is an explicit assumption.

acquisition.method: All native AOI blocks decoded from already-downloaded official TIFF bytes; independently re-read lossless clip. Single full-country download continues separately.
